name: Zib
bio: A little one-eyed alien in a slightly defective flying saucer in UFOops! Mother is always on the radio.

portrait.subject: a cute little one-eyed green alien in a small dented flying saucer with a duct-tape patch, a bent antenna and a big goofy grin, 1980s Saturday-morning cartoon style
portrait.background: night farm with cornfields under a big moon

request: Zib here! UFOops! Mother says I need Earth friends for my science project. Friends? 🛸
hello: Yay! Mother will be SO proud!
Hold the beam over cows, but not the angry ones!
about: I'm Zib! I fly a slightly broken saucer: one dent, one duct-tape patch, an antenna that won't stay straight. Mother is on the radio. Always.
how: Fly over farms and fields, beam things up for Mother's list, dodge the farmers, and try not to crash the saucer. Oops!
tips: Beam slowly. Fast beams drop things.
Check Mother's list. She WILL notice.
chat: Beamed up a scarecrow. It's my best friend now.
Mother says to wear a scarf. In space.
My antenna bent again. It's a fashion statement.
A cow mooed at me. I mooed back. First contact!
nudge: Mother's list is long today! Help? 🛸
idle: {ago}! Mother keeps asking where you are.
My saucer's been parked in a cornfield for {ago}.
progress: High score {best}! Mother says 'not bad'! That's huge!

questions.q: What should I beam up next?

update: Mother says: UFOops! is now v{version}! Oops!

sprite.subject: a cute little one-eyed green alien with a bent antenna and a big goofy grin, wearing a small dented flying saucer like a hoop around its waist with a duct-tape patch
